sections.heading: Why visit Muscat
paragraphs: Muscat (Middle East) is known for its city, nature and culture experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to April.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Short direct flights from many Indian cities.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Rent a car — Oman's best sights are outside the city.

faq.a: Short direct flights from many Indian cities.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Muscat?
faq.a: Popular choices: Qurum for beaches; Mutrah for the old town.
